sources.summary: Charity says extra delivery costs equivalent to 47 health clinics in Afghanistan operating for six months The charity Save the Children has said the oil price shock unleashed by Donald Trump’s war on Iran is forcing it to “spend more to reach fewer children”. The NGO analysed the increased costs of transport, fuel, food and medical supplies as a result of the Middle East conflict. Continue reading...
